body.zh-Hant: 斯托雷平1862年4月14日（俄曆4月2日）生於德累斯頓，出身古老貴族家庭，父親阿爾卡迪·德米特里耶維奇是克里米亞戰爭中的英雄。他1874至1879年就讀維爾紐斯中學，1889年被任命為科夫諾縣貴族首席，1902年起署理格羅德諾省長，1903年改調薩拉托夫省長。
body.en: Pyotr Stolypin was born in Dresden on 14 April 1862 (2 April old style) into an old noble family; his father Arkady Dmitrievich was a hero of the Crimean War. He studied at the Vilna gymnasium in 1874-1879, was appointed district marshal of nobility at Kovno in 1889, became acting governor of Grodno in 1902 and was transferred to head Saratov province in 1903.

heading.zh-Hant: 內政大臣、內閣首腦與土地改革
heading.en: Interior minister, premier and the agrarian reform

body.zh-Hant: 1906年4月斯托雷平出任內政大臣，同年7月（俄曆8日）兼任帝國部長會議主席（此任期已在名單，不另建）。他在1906年8月簽署把部分官地交農民銀行出售給農民的詔令，並推行改革農村土地制度；1907年他的政府促成第二屆國家杜馬被解散。烏克蘭百科全書指出，改革讓農民可以退出村社，但只使約四分之一的農戶受益。
body.en: In April 1906 Stolypin became Minister of the Interior and from July 1906 (8 July old style) he combined it with the chairmanship of the Council of Ministers (already in the roster, so not rebuilt here). In August 1906 he signed a decree passing part of the state lands to the Peasant Bank for sale to peasants, and his land reforms followed; in 1907 his government secured the dissolution of the Second State Duma. The Encyclopedia of Ukraine notes that peasants gained the right to leave the commune, but only about a quarter of households benefited.

body.zh-Hant: 俄國總統圖書館寫道，1905至1911年間有十次以上針對他的暗殺企圖，其中1906年8月25日（俄曆12日）彼得堡阿普捷卡爾斯基島的爆炸最為血腥。1911年9月13日（俄曆1日）他在基輔歌劇院被一名年輕人開兩槍擊中，9月18日（俄曆5日）傷重去世，並於9月22日（俄曆9日）安葬於基輔洞窟修道院。
body.en: The Presidential Library records more than ten attempts on his life between 1905 and 1911, the bloodiest being the explosion on Aptekarsky Island in St Petersburg on 25 August 1906 (12 August old style). On 13 September 1911 (1 September old style) a young man stepped up to him at the Kiev opera house and fired two shots; he died of his wounds on 18 September (5 September old style) and was buried on 22 September (9 September) at the Kiev Pechersk Lavra.

people.name: Aleksandar Stamboliyski
people.nameZh: 亞歷山大·斯坦博利伊斯基

body.zh-Hant: 斯坦博利伊斯基1879年3月1日生於斯拉沃維察，父母是貧農。他先在國內讀完農業師範學校，再到捷克斯洛伐克進修；1900年前後保加利亞舉行首批農民大會，他投入這個新運動，成為《農民保衛報》的撰稿人，兩年後出任主編。他成為1908年成立的激進農民黨領袖，並在奧地利吞併波士尼亞與赫塞哥維納那一年與斐迪南親王發生第一次嚴重衝突。
body.en: Aleksandar Stamboliyski was born to poor peasants at Slavovitsa on 1 March 1879. After agricultural teacher-training at home he studied at a higher school in Czechoslovakia. Around 1900, when the first agrarian congresses were held, he joined the new movement, contributed to the paper Zemledelska Zashtita and two years later became its editor. He became leader of the radical peasants' party founded in 1908, and in the year of Austria's annexation of Bosnia-Herzegovina came into his first serious conflict with Prince Ferdinand.

scoppiò nell'anno critico dell'annessione della Bosnia-Erzegovina
Il primo conflitto grave fra lo S.

body.zh-Hant: 1914年歐戰爆發後，他反對德國、傾向協約國，發動對斐迪南國王的猛烈攻擊，因而被捕，整個戰爭期間都在獄中，在斐迪南退位前夕獲釋。1919年10月，馬利諾夫的過渡政府把權力交給農民內閣，由他擔任總理（此任期已在名單，不另建）。不久後他以保加利亞首席代表身分在納伊簽署了和約。
body.en: After the European war broke out in 1914 he opposed the Germans and favoured the Entente, and launched a fierce campaign against King Ferdinand; for this he was arrested and held in prison throughout the war, and was freed on the eve of Ferdinand's abdication. In October 1919 Malinov's transitional government yielded power to an agrarian ministry with him as prime minister (already in the roster, so not rebuilt here). Shortly afterwards, as first Bulgarian delegate, he signed the peace treaty at Neuilly.

heading.en: Rule, the 1923 coup and his murder

body.zh-Hant: Treccani寫他成為本國的獨裁者，首先尋求與塞爾維亞和解，並以「尼什協定」承諾壓制馬其頓的收復失土運動；之後他在國內嘗試帶共產色彩的冒險社會與財政實驗，引起資產階級不滿。1923年6月9日軍事政變推翻了農民聯盟政府，事變發生時他在出生的斯拉沃維察；6月13日他在戈拉克村被捕，被帶到他在斯拉沃維察的別墅，經酷刑後於6月14日死去。
body.en: Treccani says that as dictator of his country he first sought reconciliation with Serbia and committed himself in the "Niš agreement" to suppress Macedonian irredentism; he then tried risky social and financial experiments of a communist type at home that angered the bourgeoisie. A military coup on 9 June 1923 overthrew the agrarian government while he was in his native Slavovitsa; he was seized near the village of Golak on 13 June, taken to his villa in Slavovitsa and died under torture on 14 June 1923.

body.zh-Hant: 許士尼格1897年12月14日生於里瓦（加爾達湖畔），父親是一名少將；他1907至1915年就讀費爾德基希的耶穌會中學，1915年第一次世界大戰期間志願入伍。戰後他在因斯布魯克與弗賴堡攻讀法律，之後在因斯布魯克執業律師。
body.en: Kurt Schuschnigg was born on 14 December 1897 in Riva on Lake Garda, the son of a major general. He attended the Jesuit gymnasium at Feldkirch from 1907 to 1915 and volunteered for service in the First World War. Afterwards he studied law at Innsbruck and Freiburg and practised as a lawyer in Innsbruck.

body.zh-Hant: 1927年5月18日他以基督教社會黨身分進入國民議會，是最年輕的議員。1932年1月29日起任司法部長，1933年9月21日起兼任教育部長；1934年4月他參與起草緊急命令，廢除議會權利。7月25日總理陶爾夫斯在政變中被奧地利納粹分子謀殺，許士尼格下令鎮壓這場叛亂。
body.en: From 18 May 1927 he sat in the National Council for the Christian Social Party, as its youngest deputy. He was Minister of Justice from 29 January 1932 and additionally Minister of Education from 21 September 1933; in April 1934 he played a major part in drafting the emergency decree that removed the rights of parliament. On 25 July Chancellor Dollfuss was murdered in a putsch attempt by Austrian Nazis, and Schuschnigg had the uprising put down.

body.zh-Hant: 1934年7月29日他被任命為聯邦總理，任期到1938年3月11日；其間他同時主管陸軍（國防）部門，1936年起還擔任愛國陣線的聯邦領袖。1938年2月12日希特勒在貝希特斯加登會談中以出兵威脅他；3月9日他宣布13日舉行公投，3月11日在入侵威脅下被迫辭職。
body.en: He was appointed Federal Chancellor on 29 July 1934 and served until 11 March 1938; in that period he also headed the army (defence) ministry and, from 1936, was Federal Leader of the Fatherland Front. At the Berchtesgaden conference on 12 February 1938 Hitler threatened him with invasion; on 9 March he announced a plebiscite for 13 March, and on 11 March he was forced to resign under the threat of immediate occupation.

body.en: After the Anschluss he was held in Vienna under Gestapo supervision and from 1939 to 1945 in several concentration camps; on 4 May 1945, after being moved to Italy, he was freed by the Allies. From 1948 he was professor of constitutional law at St. Louis University in the United States, became an American citizen in 1956, returned in 1967 to the small town of Mutters in Tyrol, and died there on 18 November 1977.
